headline: Nifty eyes rebound after record 8-week losing streak; Orient Cables and AceVector to list today.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian benchmarks recorded their longest weekly losing run in 25 years after an eight-week decline.
Persistent FII selling has significantly impacted market sentiment, with Rs 9 lakh crore wiped out recently.
Markets are betting on an RBI rate hike as domestic inflation pressures continue to build.
Global cues include a firm US dollar and crude oil prices dipping to $101 despite geopolitical tensions.
whatHappening: Orient Cables and AceVector are set to debut on the exchanges today with positive grey market premiums.
ideaForge has secured a major domestic order for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs).
L&T has been awarded significant road infrastructure contracts in Dubai.
The Vishal Nirmiti IPO enters its third day of subscription with a 9% grey market premium.
summary: The Indian market seeks a relief rally today after a historic 8-week losing streak and heavy FII selling. Focus remains on the upcoming RBI MPC meeting and new listings like Orient Cables and AceVector. Specific stock gains are expected for ideaForge and L&T following major contract wins.
